title: Silver Consumer Electricals IPO
summary: Silver Consumer Electricals IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹1,400 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Silver Consumer Electricals IPO has a total issue size of ₹1400 Crores Approx. and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd., ICICI Securities Ltd., JM Financial Ltd., Choice Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Silver Consumer Electricals financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated in 2021, Silver Consumer Electricals Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing electrical consumer durables and agricultural equipment. Its product portfolio consists of pumps and motors, solar pumps and controllers, fans, lighting products, other electrical appliances, and agricultural machinery.It operates a single location, vertically integrated manufacturing facility spread across 138,821 square meters in Rajkot, Gujarat. · · Silver Consumer Electricals operates through a two-pronged business model: · Manufacturing and selling of products under its own brands 'Silver' and 'Bediya' · Various products are designed and manufactured in-house and supplied to original equipment manufacturers in India. · · As at 31 March 2025, the R&D function of the company included personnel comprising researchers, engineers, tool/die makers, and others who are actively involved in the development, testing, and innovation of new products or improvement of existing ones. The total number of personnel in the company's R&D function as of that date was 111. · The firm had a total of 977 machines in its manufacturing setup. As of Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023, the firm had 3,450, 2,866 and 1,088 full-time employees respectively.
